cv_scheme: 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold on patient_id (dev pool = train+val), epochs=25 (matches main training run)
augmentation: horizontal flip + small affine transform on training only

significance_tests.primary: Wilcoxon signed-rank across 5 paired CV-fold macro-F1 scores (Final GNN vs best baseline) — see significance_test_PRIMARY_wilcoxon.csv
significance_tests.secondary: Exact McNemar on the single held-out test set — see significance_test_SECONDARY_mcnemar.csv

model_improvements: GraphSAGE variant added to the ablation sweep (A6)
optimizer and LR-schedule isolated as separate ablation axes (A7, A8)
fixes_vs_original_task3_notebook: Patient-grouped train/val/test split (was plain stratified split by image; risked leaking the same patient across splits).
Patient-grouped 5-fold CV via StratifiedGroupKFold (was StratifiedKFold, no grouping).
CV epochs raised to match the main run (was 12 vs 25, under-training CV folds).
Added the actual Task-2-style 'best baseline' (classical ML on ResNet50 features), re-run on this split, instead of only comparing to a freshly invented 'Improved CNN'.
Added related-work numbers with citations to the final comparison.
Switched the primary significance test to Wilcoxon signed-rank on the CV folds; kept McNemar on the single test split as a clearly-labelled secondary check.
Explainability (SHAP + LIME) is intentionally NOT in this notebook — see the companion notebook 'GroupNN_Dataset_task3_XAI_SHAP_LIME.ipynb'.
